summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script (ensurePlatformBinary) downloads a.tgz archive from the hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/, then extracts it, chmods the contained binary to 0755, hardlinks it into bin/.onecode, and prepares it for execution. The HTTPS request is made with rejectUnauthorized:false, so TLS certificate verification is disabled, and no hash or signature check is performed on the downloaded bytes. On npm install, any party controlling that IP address or the network path between the installer and it can substitute arbitrary executable content that will run on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
